name: @kickside/hub-ui
title: KickSide Hub
description: Module catalog / install / uninstall web component for kickside/hub, over the keeper hub API.

wippy.description: Ships two admin web components. kickside-hub is the Modules settings surface for catalog details and Keeper-backed install, update, and uninstall plans. kickside-onboard-modules is the standalone workspace setup menu: it loads registry-declared capability bundles, allows several bundles to be selected together, de-duplicates their packages, and installs the reviewed queue sequentially only after an explicit confirmation. Choose your own can add grounded AI recommendations or manually browsed catalog packages to the same review list. Hub has no Agents dependency. Both use the authenticated Wippy proxy API; successful lifecycle changes dispatch kickside:modules-changed for host refresh.
